reply.text:
This one is outside what I'll coach. Cutting water and manipulating hydration before a shoot is a health risk, and I won't give a water or electrolyte protocol for it. Dehydrating yourself can affect your heart, kidneys and blood pressure, and it's worth talking it through with a doctor before you try anything like that.

What I can help with is the training side. If you're aiming to look leaner on camera, we can work on a training block that keeps your strength up while you adjust your eating with a dietitian, and I can pull your recent lifts and sessions to plan around your photoshoot date. Tell me when the shoot is and what you're training for right now.
